title: Sexual Coercion
summary: Sexual coercion is pressuring someone into sexual activity through guilt, threats, repeated nagging, manipulation or using power over them. Agreement obtained this way isn't real consent.
key_points: Examples: 'If you loved me you would', threatening to leave or to share photos, continuing after a no.
It's never the pressured person's fault.
answer_guidance: Be clear and supportive. If the user seems to be experiencing this, prioritise their safety and mention they can reach trusted people or local helplines.
